name: Enchant v3
description: Iambic's 41-billion-parameter multimodal transformer that predicts molecular properties and preclinical and clinical endpoints for drug discovery.

attributes.provenance_note: Developed by Iambic (Iambic Therapeutics). Third generation after Enchant v1 (2024, 1B parameters) and v2 (2025, 7B); kept separate from those versions and from NeuralPLexer.

profile.summary: Enchant v3 is Iambic's multimodal transformer for drug discovery. It predicts molecular properties and preclinical and clinical endpoints from structures, sequences, omics, assay data, text and images, and Iambic uses it to choose compounds and prioritise experiments.
profile.summary_source_locator: enchant-v3-20261102-source-report: introduction and 'Ingest diverse data'; enchant-v3-20261102-source-release: subtitle and highlights

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: A mixture-of-experts transformer trained jointly on many data types and endpoints, so that data on one endpoint or molecule informs predictions for related ones. Each prediction carries an uncertainty estimate, which Iambic uses to decide which experiments to run. The model is fine-tuned each week on new laboratory data.
sections.source_locator: enchant-v3-20261102-source-report: 'Leverage model scale', 'Convert model outputs into probability-guided decisions', 'How Enchant impacts discovery at Iambic', 'Enchant v3: Achieving scalable predictability'

sections.title: Versions
sections.body: Enchant v1 (2024) had 1 billion parameters and Enchant v2 (2025) 7 billion. Enchant v3 has 41 billion. New in v3: inverse design, omics-based and image-based prediction, and peptides. Results and access terms of v1 or v2 do not carry over to v3. NeuralPLexer is a separate Iambic model for protein-ligand structure.
sections.source_locator: enchant-v3-20261102-source-report: 'Enchant v3: Achieving scalable predictability'; enchant-v3-20261102-source-platform: platform description

strengths.text: Iambic reports that prediction accuracy improved with scale across Enchant v1, v2 and v3, on preclinical and clinical endpoints.
strengths.source_locator: enchant-v3-20261102-source-report: Figure 5 caption and text; enchant-v3-20261102-source-release: 'Predictable scaling laws'

limitations.text: All descriptions and figures are reported by the developer. No independent evaluation of v3 was found.
The IAM-C1 and IAM217 programmes are case studies of drug programmes that used Enchant, not evaluations of the model; the report does not separate v3's contribution.
limitations.source_locator: enchant-v3-20261102-source-report: 'Example #1: IAM-C1 for CDK2/4' and 'Example #2: IAM217 for KIF18A'

limitations.text: Figure 7 compares structure prediction with ESM3 and DPLM-2 on held-out CASP14 and CAMEO22 structures, but does not say which Enchant version or which ESM3 and DPLM-2 configurations were used, which structures were held out, or how TM-scores were averaged.
limitations.source_locator: enchant-v3-20261102-source-report: 'Enchant excels at token-based structure prediction' and Figure 7

gaps: No result is recorded: Figure 7's TM-score labels lack the configuration, split and averaging details needed for a result.
No weights, public API, model card or licence for v3 was located.
Training data composition and endpoint-level accuracy are not reported.
